data.title: Young activist 'Tawan' sentenced to 2 years' jail for lese majesty
data.description: Twenty-four-year-old activist Tantawan "Tawan" Tuatulanon was on Monday sentenced to two years in prison, without suspension, for lese majesty in her Facebook livestream protesting against police clearing a route for a royal motorcade in 2022.

data.title: Why MFA Must Become a Security Baseline for Thai Organisations
data.description: The expansion of digital services, cloud environments, and data connectivity between organizations has enabled both public- and private-sector organizations to serve citizens and customers more quickly. At the same time, however, it has created more opportunities for threat actors to impersonate legitimate users and gain unauthorized access to systems, particularly in organizations that still rely primarily on a “username and password.”

data.title: TrueVisions NOW and NTT DOCOMO stream Vivant to Thai viewers days after Japan broadcast
data.description: In an era where the streaming market competition is measured not only by the volume of content but also by the speed of access and an experience that meets audience demands, TrueVisions NOW x NTT DOCOMO are advancing their strategic content partnership between Thailand and Japan through the “Lemino Japanese Collection” on the TrueVisions NOW app. High-quality Japanese series are delivered to Thai audiences within the same week as their Japanese broadcast, complete with Thai subtitles and Thai dubbing. This reinforces a collaborative model that seamlessly connects content, platforms and fan communities. The partnership continues to deliver experiences from the streaming platform to on-site activities at NIPPON HAKU BANGKOK 2026, a grand Japanese festival held from Aug 28-30, 2026, at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center. The highlight is the new season of “VIVANT”, an action-adventure blockbuster series featuring a thrilling, life-staking secret mission, which creates a space for Thai fans to get up close with the actors and creators and experience the story through activities designed specifically for engagement.

data.title: Passengers stranded overnight by Kenya airport strike
data.description: NAIROBI — Hundreds of passengers were stranded at Kenya's main international airport overnight as the latest strike by workers entered a second day on Monday.

data.title: Iran, US trade fire in first exchange for a month
data.description: TEHRAN — Iran attacked United States military targets in the Middle East on Monday in retaliation for American strikes on an island in the Strait of Hormuz, the first exchange of fire for a month in a war that has engulfed the region.

data.title: Rescuers hunt for missing after deadly Northern Cyprus ferry accident
data.description: ISTANBUL - Rescuers were on Monday still hunting for survivors a day after a ferry capsized off Northern Cyprus, leaving eight dead and more than a dozen missing, authorities said.

data.title: Pregnant teacher ends her life after boyfriend denies paternity
data.description: A pregnant teacher has commited suicide in her car, leaving a letter citing heartbreak because her boyfriend refused to acknowledge paternity of their child.

data.title: BDMS to Host Annual Academic Conference 2026 on AI-Era Healthcare Innovation
data.description: Bangkok, August 27, 2026 – Bangkok Dusit Medical Services Public Company Limited (BDMS) is reaffirming its commitment to advancing medical and multidisciplinary excellence while promoting ongoing academic collaboration and knowledge exchange. The company will host the BDMS Academic Annual Meeting 2026 under the theme “Innovative Healthcare Across the Lifespan” from Nov 9-13, 2026, at the BDMS Connect Center, Wireless Road, Bangkok. Held in a hybrid format with onsite participation and online access via Zoom, the conference will broaden access to medical knowledge and provide a platform for healthcare professionals, academics, researchers, and interested participants nationwide to exchange ideas and experiences. Registration is open through October 20, 2026.

data.title: South Korea court gives Unification Church leader 2 years prison
data.description: SEOUL - A South Korean court sentenced the leader of the secretive and powerful Unification Church on Monday to two years in prison on charges of bribing officials, including the then president's wife.

data.title: Leopard cat killed crossing M6 motorway
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - A leopard cat, a protected wild species, was struck by a car and killed while crossing the M6 motorway in Lam Takhong district, in an incident caught on camera that went viral online.

data.title: Dept sacks 3,868 local officials for cheating in recruitment exam
data.description: The Department of Local Administration terminated the employment of 3,868 officials nationwide on Monday, suspecting them of rigging their recruitment examination results late last year.

data.title: Nepal recovers bodies but presses on for trapped tunnel workers
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Nepali rescuers raced on Monday in a bid to free dozens of hydropower workers believed trapped in tunnels after devastating floods as search efforts entered a sixth day, officials said.

data.title: Grand Canyon flash flood leaves one dead, around 15 missing
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - At least one person was killed and around 15 others are missing after a flash flood at the Grand Canyon, one of the most popular tourist sites in the United States, the National Park Service said in a statement Sunday.

data.title: Thailand Real Estate Awards 2026 Celebrates 10 Years; AP Thailand Takes Top Honour
data.description: Thailand’s leading developers, projects and real estate leaders gathered at Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River on 27 August for the Thailand Real Estate Awards 2026, an exclusive celebration of the very best of the country’s property industry and a landmark tenth anniversary for the awards.

data.title: Poorly Djokovic crashes out of US Open first round
data.description: NEW YORK - Ailing Novak Djokovic suffered his earliest Grand Slam exit in 20 years on Sunday, falling in five brutal sets to Mariano Navone in the first round of the US Open.

data.title: Collapsed floors prevent investigators reaching heart of Khlongthom fire
data.description: Police investigators on Monday could not reach the point of origin amid the debris of the fire that destroyed the Klongthom Centre in Bangkok last week because two upper floors had collapsed on top of it. Arson has still not been ruled out.

data.title: US carrier visit to Thailand's Pattaya lifts hope and sex-tourism risk
data.description: After a long deployment in the Middle East, a US Navy aircraft carrier will dock in Thailand's resort city of Pattaya this week, raising hopes of an economic boost, even as local authorities cracked down on parts of the sex tourism destination.

data.title: Hong Kong police investigate viral video of dog trapped in running washing machine
data.description: Hong Kong police are investigating social media videos that appear to show a dog trapped inside a running washing machine.
